At just 14 years old, freshman high schooler Evan Yadegari scaled his consumer productivity app, Locked, to over $14,000 a month in revenue. In this episode of the Superwall Podcast, host Joseph Choi sits down with Evan to break down the exact bootstrapped playbook used to scale the app with almost zero budget. 

Evan reveals how he moved past the shadow of his older brother Zach (founder of Cal AI) by aggressively testing every digital marketing channel including Paid Ads, Reddit, and X before discovering a highly repeatable influencer marketing strategy that outpaced everything else. He breaks down his structural approach to manual outreach, navigating platform rate limits, setting up high-performing creative briefs, and structuring custom contracts that protect budget while guaranteeing viewer distribution.

We also dive into his latest project, 10X (an AI-powered "Shopify for apps" development pipeline that generated $30K ARR in its first 30 days), and map out his exact step-by-step formula to speedrun a brand-new problem-solution utility app to $10,000 a month using modern generative software like Claude and native iOS tools.
